summary_en: 3,000,000 shares (2.58% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-12 at ¥486/share (closing price 2026-08-10), up to ¥1,500M total. Single trading session order.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-market transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: VT Holdings announced on 2026-08-10 that its board of directors has authorized the acquisition of up to 3,000,000 treasury shares (2.58% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) for a total outlay not to exceed ¥1,500,000,000. The shares will be purchased via ToSTNeT-3 (off-market transaction) on 2026-08-12 at 08:45 JST at the closing price of ¥486 per share recorded on 2026-08-10. The purchase order is valid for that single trading session only; partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. The issuer stated the purpose as improving capital efficiency and enabling flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. Results will be announced after the trading session concludes.
